type-definition.comment: defrecord/defprotocol/deftype are scoped keyword.control by the host, but the NAME that follows is left unscoped. Tag both so they read like Java's `record`/`interface` plus its type name.

ns-form.comment: (ns foo.bar) is Java's `package foo.bar;` - keyword plus a muted identifier path.

clojure-keyword.comment: Clojure keywords (:debug, :info) are the closest thing to enum constants, and the host grammar gives them no scope at all.
clojure-keyword.name: constant.other.keyword.clojure

metadata.comment: ^:const and ^String metadata is Clojure's annotation syntax.
metadata.name: storage.modifier.metadata.clojure
